IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
BAIL APPLICATION NO.2865 OF 2025
Sandeep Kumar Ramchandra Pandey …  Applicant
V/s.
State of Maharashtra …  Respondent
Mr. Swatesh Tripathi i/b Mr. Rammani Upadhyay, for
the Applicant.
Mr. Prasanna P . Malshe, APP for the State – respondent.
CORAM : AMIT BORKAR, J.
DATED : JULY 17, 2025
P.C.:
1. The  learned  Advocate  for  the  applicant,  on  instructions,
submits that during pendency of the present bail applicat ion, the
prosecution  has  filed  charge-sheet  against  the  applicant.  He,
therefore, seeks permission to withdraw the present applicatio n
with liberty to approach the Trial Court for appropriate relief.
2. Permission, as prayed for, is granted.
3. The Bail Application stands disposed of as withdrawn with
liberty as prayed for.
(AMIT BORKAR, J.)
